characters.name: Slippery Jim diGriz
characters.description: Narrator and Special Corps agent who investigates the construction and theft of a Warlord-class battleship; uses deceptive identities during the mission.

characters.name: Inskipp
characters.description: Head of the Special Corps; diGriz's superior who assigns and authorizes the investigation.

characters.name: President Ferraro
characters.description: President of Cittanuvo who is initially implicated by falsified plans and who assists diGriz's inquiry into the stolen ship.

characters.name: Rocca
characters.description: Manager of the Cenerentola Spaceyards where the ship was constructed; provides records used in the investigation.

characters.name: Pepe Nero
characters.description: Mastermind criminal (or assumed name) who organizes the covert conversion and theft of the battleship; responsible for deadly raids.

characters.name: Angelina
characters.description: Female assistant and co-conspirator in the battleship scheme; implicated as the originator of the plot and who escapes at the end.

characters.name: Captain Steng
characters.description: Captain of the League cruiser assigned to diGriz's operation; skeptical of diGriz's unorthodox tactics.

characters.name: psiman
characters.description: Ship communications/psionic operator who decodes and transmits classified psionic messages and coordinates long-distance contacts.

characters.name: navigator
characters.description: Ship navigator who plots probable locations of the stolen battleship using the ship's tank and provides movement calculations.

characters.name: M-3 robot
characters.description: A multifunctional Corps robot that accompanies diGriz, equipped with concealed compartments, detection devices and programmed roles in the investigation.
